title: Grateful Dead Live at Capital Centre on 1980-08-31

ai_review.summary: Mixed source with a strong soundboard portion; overall good audio and a solid performance.
ai_review.review: The reviewer gave the set a four‑star rating, noting that the soundboard recording (set 2) is superior to the audience tape of set 1. No specific musical criticisms or praises were mentioned, indicating an overall satisfactory show that sounds clear where the soundboard feed is used.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one review (4 ★) mentions the SBD as better, giving a positive but limited view of both show and recording quality.
